name: find-contract-by-id
displayName: Find contract by ID or code
description: Looks up a supplier contract by its literal identifier (e.g. CTR-2026-101, sup-42, MTC-4471). Uses the hybrid-retrieval OData action on the CAP backend — vector similarity fused with keyword matching via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Where a semantic-only search would miss exact identifiers, hybrid picks them up because keyword scoring rewards the literal-token match.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The literal contract or supplier identifier — e.g. CTR-YYYY-NNN, sup-NN, MTC-NNNN.
